text.tspan: Support from peers mattered more than the
LinkedIn congratulations.
The part dashboards miss is the human
friction. The title changes, but the
expectations change more.
Lead the work you already know before
reinventing everything.
Imposter feelings are data, not a veto.
My first week will be listening tours, not
grand plans.
New authority without new listening is just
louder guessing.
